MERCH_D1_001.speaker: Merchant
MERCH_D1_001.text: Welcome! You must be the new farmer. I run the village shop. Come in whenever you need supplies.

PLAYER_MERCH_D1_001.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_MERCH_D1_001.text: Nice to meet you! What can I find here?

MERCH_D1_002.speaker: Merchant
MERCH_D1_002.text: I sell seeds, farming supplies, and useful everyday materials. You can also sell me the crops and resources you collect.

PLAYER_MERCH_D1_002.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_MERCH_D1_002.text: That will help. I need to get my farm working again.

MERCH_D1_003.speaker: Merchant
MERCH_D1_003.text: Start small. Plant a few seeds, water them every day, and bring your harvest here when it is ready. A steady income adds up!

PLAYER_MERCH_D1_003.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_MERCH_D1_003.text: I heard the city wants to take this land. Is the shop affected too?

MERCH_D1_004.speaker: Merchant
MERCH_D1_004.text: Yes, and I am worried. This shop depends on the village. I hope we can keep our homes and businesses here.

MERCH_D1_005.speaker: Merchant
MERCH_D1_005.text: For now, focus on building up your farm. If you need seeds or want to sell something, my door is open.

PLAYER_MERCH_D1_004.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_MERCH_D1_004.text: Thank you. I will be back when I have my first harvest!

MERCH_D1_006.speaker: Merchant
MERCH_D1_006.text: I look forward to it! Good luck, and welcome to the village.
